// FlowGuard fixture: SYNTHETIC, not copied. Planning Tool has no Prisma connect, connectOrCreate,
// disconnect or $executeRaw write; these calls are written only against the copied
// backend/prisma/schema.prisma.txt models (Employee, UserRole, EmployeeTransfer).
export async function requestTransfer(prisma: any, employeeId: string, actorId: string, target: string) {
  return prisma.employeeTransfer.create({
    data: {
      targetOrgUnitId: target,
      commandKey: 'transfer-key',
      employee: { connect: { id: employeeId } },
      requestedBy: { connect: { id: actorId } },
    },
  });
}

export async function clearDecision(prisma: any, id: string) {
  await prisma.employeeTransfer.update({ where: { id }, data: { decidedBy: { disconnect: true }, status: 'PENDING' } });
}

export async function attachRole(prisma: any, employeeId: string, roleId: string) {
  await prisma.employee.update({ where: { id: employeeId }, data: { roles: { connect: [{ id: roleId }] } } });
}

export async function ensureRole(prisma: any, employeeId: string) {
  await prisma.userRole.upsert({
    where: { id: 'role-id' },
    update: { role: 'EMPLOYEE' },
    create: {
      role: 'EMPLOYEE',
      employee: {
        connectOrCreate: {
          where: { id: employeeId },
          create: { name: 'n', email: 'e', sapReference: 1, startDate: new Date(), employeeStatusId: 's', resourceTypeId: 'r' },
        },
      },
    },
  });
}

export async function moveRaw(prisma: any, id: string, unit: string) {
  await prisma.$executeRaw`UPDATE [dbo].[employees] SET [organizational_unit_id] = ${unit} WHERE [id] = ${id}`;
  await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe('DELETE FROM user_roles WHERE employee_id = @P1', id);
}

export async function patch(prisma: any, id: string, changes: Record<string, unknown>) {
  await prisma.employee.update({ where: { id }, data: { ...changes } });
}

export function forget(cache: Map<string, number>, key: string) {
  this.cache.delete(key);
  cache.delete(key);
}
